title_en: Wang Chongyu and Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd. — Retrial Compensation for Acquittal Case
ruling_gist_en: In state compensation cases, the determination that the property rights of the compensation claimant have been infringed is based on the claimant's lawful rights and interests in the property involved. The compensation committee of the people's court's judgment on the ownership of the property involved shall be bound by the res judicata of effective criminal, civil, and other adjudicative documents. If the compensation claimant disagrees with the relevant determination in the effective judgment, it shall be resolved through the trial supervision procedure.

full_text_en:
Wang Chongyu v. Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd. — Retrial Innocence Compensation Case

【Ruling Summary】

In state compensation cases, the determination that the property rights of the compensation claimant have been infringed is based on the claimant's lawful rights and interests in the property in question. The judgment of the compensation committee of the People's Court on the ownership of the property in question shall be bound by the res judicata of effective criminal, civil, and other judgment documents. If the compensation claimant disagrees with the relevant determination in the effective judgment, the matter shall be resolved through trial supervision procedures.

The general principle of state compensation is "who infringes, who compensates," with the exception of post-positioned absorption of liability. In special circumstances, the post-positioned absorption of liability for compensation is the unification of substantive post-positioned absorption and procedural post-positioned absorption, and is premised on substantive post-positioned absorption, in order to balance the dual purposes of the State Compensation Law in providing relief for private rights and regulating public powers, and to achieve a balance between facilitating compensation claimants in applying for compensation and compelling the compensation obligor to perform its duties in accordance with the law.

State Compensation Decision of the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court

(2016) Zui Gao Fa Wei Pei Jian No. 145

Complainant (Compensation Claimant): Wang Chongyu (also known as Wang Kai), male, born on October 6, 1973, Han ethnicity, formerly the executive director of Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd., residing in Chun'an County, Zhejiang Province.

Complainant (Compensation Claimant): Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room 3-12-102, Shiban New Village, Xiacheng District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

Legal Representative: Wang Chongyu, executive director of the company.

Respondent (Compensation Obligor): Jinhua Intermediate People's Court, Zhejiang Province. Domicile: No. 1096 Liyu Road, Wucheng District, Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.

Legal Representative: Tang Haiqing, president of the court.

The complainants, Wang Chongyu and Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huayu Company), dissatisfied with the state compensation decision of the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Zhejiang High Court) (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14, filed a complaint with the Compensation Committee of this Court regarding the application for retrial innocence compensation from Jinhua Intermediate People's Court, Zhejiang Province (hereinafter referred to as Jinhua Intermediate Court). The Compensation Committee of this Court has examined this case in accordance with the law, and the review has now been concluded.

Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company complained: The erroneous judgment of Jinhua Intermediate Court led to Wang Chongyu, who was in the prime of his youth, being illegally infringed upon for twelve years, hindering his career development, leaving him homeless to this day, and causing the cessation of Huayu Company's operations, resulting in huge losses. The state compensation decision of the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14, regarding compensation for infringement of personal freedom, did not consider the damage to personal freedom during Wang Chongyu's parole period or the loss of income as a professional manager, etc.; regarding compensation for infringement of property rights, the amount of recovered funds to be returned should be RMB 3,983,749.84, with interest calculated at the daily rate of 0.021% as determined by the Civil Judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087 of Dongyang People's Court, Zhejiang Province. Therefore, they requested the annulment of the state compensation decision of the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14 and the state compensation decision of Jinhua Intermediate Court (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1, and sought a decision: (1) ordering Jinhua Intermediate Court to compensate Wang Chongyu for losses from infringement of personal freedom during his detention and parole period, totaling RMB 3,662,952.12, professional manager compensation of RMB 18 million, labor remuneration during imprisonment of RMB 225,153, social insurance contributions of RMB 500,000, and other losses totaling RMB 22,388,105; (2) ordering Jinhua Intermediate Court to compensate at ten times the standard for the loss of recovered funds of RMB 39,837,498.4, fine loss of RMB 800,000, prepaid litigation costs of RMB 377,660 in 2003; compensation for attorney fees of RMB 1 million, personal rent loss of RMB 50,000, travel expenses for appeals from 2011 to 2014 of RMB 300,000, economic losses of relatives of RMB 2 million, etc., totaling property losses of RMB 44,525,158; (3) compensation for moral damages of RMB 23,419,642; (4) compensation for business losses in real estate, internet, etc., of RMB 900 million; (5) provision for Wang Chongyu of a commercial apartment with an area of 120 to 150 square meters in Hangzhou urban area and a car worth RMB 500,000; (6) ordering Jinhua Intermediate Court to apologize to Wang Chongyu in Chun'an County, Hangzhou City, and national-level media, to eliminate the adverse effects and restore his reputation; restore the legal validity of Wang Chongyu's performance agent qualification certificate, sports agent qualification certificate, and other agent qualification certificates; (7) recognizing Huayu Company's qualification as a compensation claimant in accordance with the law, and ordering Jinhua Intermediate Court to compensate the company for office rental, equipment losses of RMB 160,000, and business losses of RMB 100 million, and restore the legal validity of the company's business license; (8) investigating the liability of relevant personnel involved in investigation, prosecution, and adjudication for handling wrongful convictions; (9) investigating the criminal liability of Zhejiang Hengdian Film City Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hengdian Film Company) for the crime of false accusation.

Upon review, the Compensation Committee of this Court finds:

On August 5, 2003, Wang Chongyu established Huayu Company, which he actually controlled personally. On October 4 of the same year, Huayu Company entered into a performance contract and a supplementary contract with Hengdian Film Company to host the large-scale public welfare evening gala "Same Song · Entering the United Nations Asia-Pacific Decade of Disabled Persons" and the opening ceremony of the Fifth China Farmers' Tourism Festival. On October 4, 8, and 17 of the same month, Hengdian Film Company paid Huayu Company a total of RMB 4.48 million in performance fees. On October 21 of the same year, the Opera and Music Department of the Literature and Art Center of China Central Television decided to stop recording the program. On October 24, 2003, Huayu Company filed a civil lawsuit with Jinhua Intermediate Court, claiming that Hengdian Film Company had breached the contract and seeking compensation; Jinhua Intermediate Court accepted the case with case number (2003) Jin Zhong Min Er Chu Zi No. 228, and Huayu Company prepaid litigation costs of RMB 37,660. On October 27 of the same year, Hengdian Film Company reported to the Dongyang Public Security Bureau, Zhejiang Province, alleging that Wang Chongyu was suspected of contract fraud. The Dongyang Public Security Bureau detained Wang Chongyu criminally on November 26, 2003, and sent a letter to Jinhua Intermediate Court on November 27 of the same year requesting the transfer of the case. On December 2, 2003, Jinhua Intermediate Court transferred the case (2003) Jin Zhong Min Er Chu Zi No. 228 to the Dongyang Public Security Bureau for handling. On December 31 of the same year, Wang Chongyu was arrested. During the investigation, the Dongyang Public Security Bureau recovered RMB 1,923,452 from Wang Chongyu's involved funds and froze relevant deposits of Huayu Company amounting to RMB 2,060,297.84; the recovered fund of RMB 1,923,452 was returned to Hengdian Film Company by the Dongyang Public Security Bureau on April 30, 2004; the frozen deposit of RMB 2,060,297.84 was continued to be frozen by the first-instance court, Dongyang People's Court, on November 9, 2004.

On December 23, 2004, the Dongyang People's Court rendered a criminal judgment (2004) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 639, finding that Wang Chongyu had defrauded Hengdian Film Company of RMB 4.48 million, and ruled: (1) Wang Chongyu was guilty of contract fraud, sentenced to fourteen years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000; guilty of forging official seals of institutions, sentenced to one year's imprisonment; the combined sentence was fourteen years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000; (2) The frozen deposit of Huayu Company of RMB 2,060,297.84 was to be returned to Hengdian Film Company; continued recovery of stolen goods of RMB 496,250.16 to be returned to Hengdian Film Company. Wang Chongyu appealed. On March 29, 2005, Jinhua Intermediate Court rendered a criminal ruling (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 40, quashing the criminal judgment (2004) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 639 of Dongyang People's Court and remanding the case for retrial.

On June 23, 2005, the Dongyang People's Court, upon retrial, rendered a criminal judgment (2005) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 227, with the same content as (2004) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 639. Wang Chongyu again appealed. On September 29 of the same year, Jinhua Intermediate Court rendered a criminal judgment (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 112, finding that Wang Chongyu had defrauded Hengdian Film Company of RMB 2.22 million, and ruled: (1) Upholding the conviction part of Wang Chongyu and the sentencing part for forging official seals of institutions in the first-instance criminal judgment (2005) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 227; quashing other parts; (2) Wang Chongyu was guilty of contract fraud, sentenced to twelve years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 40,000; guilty of forging official seals of institutions, sentenced to one year's imprisonment; the combined sentence was twelve years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 40,000; (3) Continued recovery of stolen goods and return to the victim unit. After the criminal judgment (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 112 took effect, the Dongyang People's Court, out of the frozen deposit of RMB 2,060,297.84, used RMB 40,000 to offset the fine and turned it over to the state treasury; used RMB 296,548 as stolen goods and returned it to Hengdian Film Company on October 21, 2005; the remaining RMB 1.72 million was paid to Hengdian Film Company as enforcement funds for the civil judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087. Thus, Hengdian Film Company had successively received criminal recovery payments of RMB 1,923,452 from the Dongyang Public Security Bureau and RMB 296,548 from the Dongyang People's Court, totaling RMB 2.22 million.

On May 19, 2011, Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court rendered a criminal ruling (2011) Zhe Hang Xing Zhi Zi No. 4725, granting parole to Wang Chongyu. On June 9, 2011, Wang Chongyu was released on parole, having been detained for a total of 2,753 days. On December 11, 2013, the People's Procuratorate of Zhejiang Province issued a Notice of Review of Criminal Appeal (Zhe Jian Kong Shen Fu Tong [2013] No. 4), holding that the facts of Wang Chongyu's crime of contract fraud could not be established, the sentencing for forging official seals of institutions was excessive, and recommending that Zhejiang High Court initiate trial supervision procedures for retrial. On December 19 of the same year, Zhejiang High Court rendered a retrial decision (2012) Zhe Xing Shen Zi No. 136, instructing Jinhua Intermediate Court to conduct a retrial. Upon retrial, Jinhua Intermediate Court found that the circumstances of Wang Chongyu's act of forging official seals of institutions were obviously minor and harmful, and the evidence for the crime of contract fraud was insufficient, and on June 6, 2014, rendered a criminal judgment (2014) Jin Xing Zai Zi No. 2: Quashing the criminal judgments (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 112 of this court and (2005) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 227 of Dongyang People's Court; Wang Chongyu was found not guilty.

On March 6, 2015, Wang Chongyu applied to Jinhua Intermediate Court for retrial innocence compensation. On May 22, 2015, Jinhua Intermediate Court received a joint application for retrial innocence compensation from Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company. On August 10, 2015, Jinhua Intermediate Court rendered a state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1: (1) Apologize to Wang Chongyu; (2) Pay Wang Chongyu compensation for infringement of personal freedom of RMB 604,889.16 and moral damages of RMB 180,000, totaling RMB 784,899.16; (3) Return the fine of RMB 40,000 paid by Wang Chongyu and corresponding interest (calculated at the five-year bank deposit rate for the same period, from December 27, 2005, to the date of return); (4) Dismiss Wang Chongyu's other compensation claims; (5) Dismiss Huayu Company's compensation application. Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company appealed to the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court for a compensation decision. On December 2, 2015, the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court rendered a state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14: (1) Upholding items 2 and 5 of Jinhua Intermediate Court's state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1; (2) Quashing item 1 of Jinhua Intermediate Court's state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1, and changing it to requiring Jinhua Intermediate Court to eliminate the adverse effects, restore Wang Chongyu's reputation, and apologize to him; (3) Quashing item 3 of Jinhua Intermediate Court's state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1, and changing it to requiring Jinhua Intermediate Court to return the fine of RMB 40,000 paid by Wang Chongyu and pay corresponding interest of RMB 16,152.73; (4) Requiring Jinhua Intermediate Court to return the recovered funds of RMB 2.22 million and pay corresponding interest of RMB 809,687.93; (5) Dismissing Wang Chongyu's other compensation claims. Additionally, during the hearing of this case by the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court, Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court returned to Wang Chongyu the total fine of RMB 40,000 paid during the execution of his sentence.

Separately found: After the criminal judgment (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 112 took effect, on October 13, 2005, Hengdian Film Company filed a contract dispute lawsuit with Jinhua Intermediate Court, seeking confirmation that the performance contract and supplementary contract signed between Hengdian Film Company and Huayu Company on October 4, 2003, were invalid, and that Huayu Company and Wang Chongyu should return RMB 2.26 million and compensate for losses. On the same day, Jinhua Intermediate Court, due to Wang Chongyu being detained in the detention center of Dongyang Public Security Bureau and the impending expiration of the seizure period of his property, referred the case to Dongyang People's Court for trial. On December 26, 2005, Dongyang People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087: Confirming the invalidity of the aforementioned performance contract and supplementary contract; ordering Huayu Company to return RMB 2.26 million to Hengdian Film Company and compensate for interest losses of RMB 268,507.26; Wang Chongyu was to bear joint and several liability. Huayu Company and Wang Chongyu appealed. On March 13, 2006, Jinhua Intermediate Court, due to Huayu Company and Wang Chongyu's failure to prepay litigation fees as required, rendered a civil ruling (2006) Jin Zhong Min Zhong Zi No. 101, dismissing the appeal as withdrawn. On May 25 of the same year, Dongyang People's Court rendered a civil ruling (2006) Dong Zhi Zi No. 737-1, ordering the withdrawal of RMB 37,660 in unreturned litigation fees of Huayu Company held by Jinhua Intermediate Court. In the aforementioned civil case, Hengdian Film Company received an advance enforcement payment of RMB 1,726,152 from Dongyang People's Court during the litigation process and an enforcement payment of RMB 36,000 during the enforcement process, totaling RMB 1,762,152. On October 28, 2007, Huayu Company's business license was revoked due to its failure to participate in annual inspections for two consecutive years.

Further found: On August 10, 2015, Jinhua Intermediate Court, in its state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1, held that the recovered sum of RMB 2.22 million that had been returned to Hengdian Film Company was not lost, and Wang Chongyu's request for the return of that amount should be resolved separately in accordance with the law; on the same day, by letter (2014) Zhe Jin Xing Zai Zi No. 2, it notified Hengdian Film Company that the criminal judgment (2014) Zhe Jin Xing Zai Zi No. 2 had declared Wang Chongyu not guilty, and requested the company to return the RMB 2.22 million received under the original criminal judgment to Jinhua Intermediate Court. On August 11 of the same year, Hengdian Film Company again filed a contract dispute lawsuit with Dongyang People's Court, seeking the return of RMB 2.22 million obtained under the invalid contract from Huayu Company and Wang Chongyu, and compensation for interest losses. On August 12 of the same year, Hengdian Film Company, as requested by Jinhua Intermediate Court, remitted RMB 2.22 million to the Non-Tax Revenue Financial Special Account of Jinhua Municipal Finance Bureau. After the state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14 of the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court took effect, on March 4, 2016, Dongyang People's Court rendered a civil judgment (2015) Dong Shang Chu Zi No. 4788: Huayu Company was to return RMB 2.22 million in performance fees to Hengdian Film Company; Huayu Company was to compensate Hengdian Film Company for 70% of the interest loss on RMB 2.22 million; Wang Chongyu was to bear joint and several liability. This civil judgment has taken legal effect.

After the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court rendered the state compensation decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14, on December 21, 2015, Wang Chongyu applied to Jinhua Intermediate Court for payment of compensation. Jinhua Intermediate Court applied to the Jinhua Municipal Finance Bureau for payment of compensation for infringement of personal freedom of RMB 604,889.16, moral damages of RMB 180,000, the fine of RMB 40,000 and interest of RMB 16,152.73, totaling RMB 841,051.89. On December 28 of the same year, Jinhua Intermediate Court sent a letter to Hengdian Film Company, requesting the company to return the interest of RMB 809,687.93 on the RMB 2.22 million in accordance with the aforementioned state compensation decision of the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang High Court; Hengdian Film Company then remitted RMB 809,687.93 to the Non-Tax Revenue Financial Special Account of Jinhua Municipal Finance Bureau. On January 7, 2016, Wang Chongyu received compensation of RMB 841,051.89 through his account No. 6225XXXXXXXX6612 at the Hangzhou Branch of Guangdong Development Bank. On February 23 of the same year, Wang Chongyu's above bank account received interest on the original recovered funds of RMB 809,687.93; on the same day, Dongyang People's Court, by enforcement ruling (2006) Dong Zhi Zi No. 737-5, deducted RMB 809,487.26 from that account for enforcement of the outstanding balance in the civil case (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087. On August 3 of the same year, Wang Chongyu's above bank account received the original recovered funds of RMB 2.22 million; on August 4 of the same year, Dongyang People's Court, by enforcement ruling (2016) Zhe 0783 Zhi No. 4346, deducted RMB 2.22 million from that account for enforcement of the principal in the civil case (2015) Dong Shang Chu Zi No. 4788. Dongyang People's Court accordingly closed the enforcement of the civil cases (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087 and (2015) Dong Shang Chu Zi No. 4788.

The above facts are evidenced by the following: Criminal Judgment (2004) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 639, Criminal Ruling (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 40, Criminal Judgment (2005) Dong Xing Chu Zi No. 227, Criminal Judgment (2005) Jin Zhong Xing Er Zhong Zi No. 112, Notice of Review of Criminal Appeal (Zhe Jian Kong Shen Fu Tong [2013] No. 4), Retrial Decision (2012) Zhe Xing Shen Zi No. 136, Criminal Judgment (2014) Zhe Jin Xing Zai Zi No. 2, Letter (2014) Zhe Jin Xing Zai Zi No. 2, Civil Judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087, Civil Ruling (2006) Jin Zhong Min Zhong Zi No. 101, Civil Ruling (2006) Dong Zhi Zi No. 737-1, Civil Judgment (2015) Dong Shang Chu Zi No. 4788, Enforcement Ruling (2006) Dong Zhi Zi No. 737-5, Enforcement Ruling (2016) Zhe 0783 Zhi No. 4346, Notice of Case Closure, Bank Customer Statements, State Compensation Decision (2015) Zhe Jin Fa Pei Zi No. 1, State Compensation Decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14, and other evidence.

本院赔偿委员会审查认为：

The Compensation Committee of this Court, upon review, finds:

Wang Chongyu, having been convicted of contract fraud and forging a seal of a public institution by the Dongyang People's Court at first instance and by the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court at second instance, was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment and a fine, and later acquitted upon retrial by the Zhejiang High People's Court. Pursuant to Articles 17(3), 18(2), and 21(4) of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall bear the liability for compensating Wang Chongyu for the executed fixed-term imprisonment and fine imposed in the original judgment following his acquittal on retrial. Huayu Company was not a criminal defendant in the original case and therefore does not have the standing as a claimant to apply for compensation for acquittal on retrial.

(1) Regarding Wang Chongyu's claim for compensation for deprivation of personal freedom

Wang Chongyu was detained from November 26, 2003, to June 9, 2011, totaling 2,753 days of custody. State compensation is statutory compensation. The Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court and the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court decided that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall pay Wang Chongyu compensation of RMB 604,889.16 for the 2,753 days of deprivation of personal freedom, calculated at the 2014 national average daily wage of 219.72 yuan for workers. This decision complies with Article 33 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. Therefore, Wang Chongyu's claims for compensation for loss of personal freedom during custody and parole, loss of executive compensation, labor remuneration during imprisonment, social insurance contributions, and other losses totaling RMB 22,388,105 lack factual and legal basis and are not supported.

Although Wang Chongyu was acquitted on retrial because the circumstances of his offense of forging a seal of a public institution were obviously minor and not harmful, and the evidence for the offense of contract fraud was insufficient, he himself also bore fault. However, having been detained for 2,753 days, his personal life and company operations were affected. This should be determined as constituting serious consequences of mental injury under Article 35 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. By reference to paragraph 2 of Article 7 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Mental Injury Compensation in State Compensation Cases Heard by the Compensation Committees of People's Courts, mental distress damages shall in principle not exceed 35% of the total compensation for the deprivation of personal freedom. Therefore, considering the actual circumstances of this case, the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court and the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court decided that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall pay Wang Chongyu mental distress damages of RMB 180,000, equivalent to approximately 30% of the compensation for deprivation of personal freedom. This decision is not improper. The criminal retrial judgment of the Zhejiang High People's Court already declared Wang Chongyu not guilty. The decision of the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall eliminate the adverse effects, restore Wang Chongyu's reputation, and make an apology is upheld. Wang Chongyu's further claim that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall apologize in media at the county, city, and national levels is not supported.

(2) Regarding the claims of Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company for compensation for property damage

The claims for compensation for property damage by Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company fall into two categories: compensation based on acquittal on retrial and compensation based on illegal recovery in criminal proceedings. Procedurally, Wang Chongyu has standing as a claimant for both categories. Huayu Company, not being a criminal defendant in the original case, only has standing to claim compensation based on illegal recovery in criminal proceedings.

Regarding Wang Chongyu's claim for compensation for property damage based on acquittal on retrial: The fine of RMB 40,000 originally imposed on Wang Chongyu has been paid into the state treasury. After his acquittal on retrial, the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court, which rendered the original effective criminal judgment, shall bear the compensation liability. The Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court and the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court decided that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall return the original fine of RMB 40,000 to Wang Chongyu, and the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court further decided to pay interest of RMB 16,152.73 calculated at the five-year deposit rate of the same period. This decision complies with Articles 36(1) and (7) of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. In his appeal, Wang Chongyu also requested the return of another fine of RMB 40,000 plus interest. Investigation shows that this fine of RMB 40,000 was not imposed by the original effective criminal judgment of the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court but was paid during the execution of the sentence; it has already been returned by the Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court. Therefore, this compensation claim is not within the scope of review of this case.

Regarding the claims of Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company for compensation for property damage based on illegal recovery in criminal proceedings: Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company claimed in their appeal that the recovered funds that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court should return amount to RMB 3,983,749.84. Investigation shows that of the RMB 3,983,749.84 recovered and frozen from Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company, RMB 2,220,000 was returned to Hengdian Film and Television Company through criminal recovery, RMB 40,000 was paid into the state treasury as a fine, and the remaining balance of over RMB 1,720,000 was later paid to Hengdian Film and Television Company as an advance enforcement payment under Civil Judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087. The fine of RMB 40,000 and its interest have already been assumed by the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court as compensation liability for the acquittal on retrial. The over RMB 1,720,000 advance enforcement payment has had its validity confirmed by an effective civil judgment; if Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company disagree, they should resolve the matter through civil trial supervision procedures. Of the above RMB 2,220,000 recovered and returned to Hengdian Film and Television Company, RMB 1,923,452 was recovered and returned by the Dongyang Public Security Bureau during the investigation stage, and the other RMB 296,548 was returned by the Dongyang People's Court during the execution of the effective criminal judgment. Huayu Company's request for compensation naming the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court as the compensating authority is improper. After Wang Chongyu was acquitted on retrial, his conduct of receiving RMB 2,220,000 from Hengdian Film and Television Company during the performance of the contract did not constitute the crime of contract fraud. However, the effective civil judgment (2005) Dong Min Er Chu Zi No. 1087 of the Dongyang People's Court had already declared the performance contract and supplementary contract between Huayu Company and Hengdian Film and Television Company invalid. Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company lost the legal basis for receiving the RMB 2,220,000 under those contracts. The later effective civil judgment (2015) Dong Shang Chu Zi No. 4788 of the Dongyang People's Court also supported Hengdian Film and Television Company's claim for the return of those funds. Therefore, Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company's request for state compensation on the ground of illegal recovery of the RMB 2,220,000 lacks factual and legal basis. If Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company disagree with the above effective civil judgments, they should resolve the matter through civil trial supervision procedures. The aforementioned RMB 2,220,000 and interest of RMB 809,687.93 were actually transferred by Hengdian Film and Television Company and later executed back to that company through civil enforcement procedures; they were not paid from the state treasury. Therefore, the decision of the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court that the Jinhua Intermediate People's Court shall bear the state compensation liability for returning those funds and paying interest is erroneous, and that decision shall be vacated.

Wang Chongyu and Huayu Company's other claims, including compensation for litigation costs, attorney fees, rent, travel expenses, and business losses; requests that Wang Chongyu be provided with a commercial housing unit, a vehicle, and restoration of his broker qualification certificate; requests that Huayu Company be compensated for office rent, equipment, and business losses, and that its business license validity be restored; and the request to pursue criminal liability against Hengdian Film and Television Company, do not fall within the scope of compensation under the State Compensation Law and are not supported. Wang Chongyu's request to pursue liability against relevant personnel involved in the investigation, prosecution, and trial is not within the scope of review of this case.

In summary, pursuant to Articles 21(1) and 30 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, and Articles 19 and 20 of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Procedures for the Trial of State Compensation Cases by the Compensation Committees of People's Courts, the Compensation Committee of this Court decides as follows:

1. Uphold Items 1, 2, 3, and 5 of the State Compensation Decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14 of the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court;

2. Vacate Item 4 of the State Compensation Decision (2015) Zhe Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 14 of the Compensation Committee of the Zhejiang High People's Court;

3. Dismiss the appeals of Wang Chongyu and Hangzhou Huayu Culture and Art Co., Ltd.

This decision is legally effective.

January 13, 2017
